about.title: Where Infrastructure Meets Application Code
about.summary: Bridging the gap between distributed infrastructure engineering and resilient application design. Specializing in high-availability AWS deployments, microservice orchestration on Kubernetes, automated testing pipelines, and backend system optimization.
paragraphs: I manage enterprise-scale AWS environments end-to-end — from provisioning multi-region infrastructure with Terraform and Ansible to managing containerized microservices in Kubernetes clusters and ensuring round-the-clock reliability via Prometheus and Grafana dashboards.

On the development front, I build backend services and high-throughput data processing engines with PHP, Python, and MySQL on Linux, alongside modern UI components using React.js and Node.js with AI-assisted delivery workflows.
My core philosophy: Make production deployments repeatable, predictable, and resilient against any scale of operational entropy.

experience.summary: Full ownership of multi-environment AWS infrastructure, end-to-end CI/CD pipelines, and microservices containerization while delivering backend query engines and web applications.
responsibilities: Built and maintained automated CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins integrated with Azure DevOps Repos and SonarQube for automated code quality gating, drastically reducing failed production deployments.
Operated AWS cloud environments (Staging, UAT, Production) utilizing EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, ECS, Lambda, SQS, CloudFront, and CloudWatch with strict security and high availability.
Automated staging deployment workflows using Jenkins, Ansible playbooks, and Python scripts, eliminating manual release overhead.
Deployed and managed containerized microservices in UAT using Docker and Kubernetes on AWS, orchestrating ingress, autoscaling, and service discovery.
Set up comprehensive production monitoring using Prometheus and Grafana dashboards, maintaining 99.9% uptime with automated threshold alerting.
Provisioned multi-tier infrastructure for new client environments via Terraform IaC, slashing environment setup time by 80%.
Engineered query validation and correction algorithms for backend PHP/MySQL engines, improving system accuracy by 90%.
Drove legacy monolith-to-microservices migration, containerizing core services with zero customer-facing downtime during cutover.
Engineered and maintained backend APIs and web infrastructure on Apache LAMP stack alongside rapid React.js/Node.js feature development.
technologies: AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, ECS, Lambda)

projects.title: Automated Cloud CI/CD & Terraform IaC Pipeline

projects.title: Monolith to Microservices Kubernetes Migration

projects.title: Zero-Point Observability & Telemetry Grid

projects.impact: Ensured 99.9% system availability through proactive anomaly mitigation.

projects.title: High-Efficiency SQL Query Validation Engine

projects.impact: Boosted backend system execution accuracy by 90% while preventing fatal query exceptions.
